name: scan_threshold_table_lookup
description: Selects the low or high nibble of a record byte according to a table flag, then scans a table of 16-bit thresholds for the first entry not greater than the given value and stores its paired value to the output. It returns at once when the record's enable byte is zero, and copies the input value directly when the table flag is zero.

name: copy_word_from_offset_to_offset
description: Calls an unnamed routine twice, then copies a 16-bit field at one offset within a record to another offset within the same record. It makes no library calls and touches no hardware registers.

name: clamp_step_position_both_directions
description: Adds a signed step to a 16-bit position and clamps the result to a bound in the direction of the step, then stores the position in two record fields and the output. A record flag decides whether a threshold table lookup follows, and a second flag decides whether a 32-bit field is copied.

name: advance_position_capped_by_limit
description: Adds a step to a 16-bit position and caps the sum at a limit, storing the position in two record fields and the output. A record flag decides whether a threshold table lookup follows, and a second flag decides whether a 32-bit field is copied.

name: retreat_position_floored_at_limit
description: Subtracts a step from a 16-bit position and floors the difference at a limit, storing the position in two record fields and the output. A record flag decides whether a threshold table lookup follows, and a second flag decides whether a 32-bit field is copied.

name: store_position_with_table_lookup
description: Stores the input position into two record fields and the output when a record flag is zero. When the flag is set, it looks up the position in a threshold table and writes the matching value to the output, and a second flag then decides whether a 32-bit field is copied.

name: copy_long_from_offset_to_offset
description: Copies a 32-bit field at one offset within a record to another offset in the same record. It has no calls and no other side effects.

name: lookup_threshold_entry_for_value
description: Selects a threshold table with a byte lookup on the input value, scans it for the first entry not greater than the input, and stores the paired value to the output. When a flag in the record is set, it also copies a 32-bit field within the record.

name: apply_nibble_step_with_clamp
description: Adjusts a 16-bit value in a record by the high nibble of a record byte added, or by the low nibble subtracted when the high nibble is zero. A negative result is replaced by a default word and a result above a limit is clamped to that limit, and the final value is written to two record fields.

name: add_byte_step_capped_at_ceiling
description: Adds an unsigned byte from a record to a 16-bit field, limits the sum to a fixed ceiling, and writes the value to the record and to the output.

name: subtract_byte_step_floored
description: Subtracts an unsigned byte from a 16-bit field of a record, floors the difference at a fixed minimum, and writes the result to the record and to the output.

name: compute_signed_scaled_offset
description: Multiplies a table-derived or fallback scale word by a nibble from the record, divides the product by 128, and negates it when the sign bit of an accumulator byte is set. The offset is added to a base field and written to the output, and the accumulator byte advances by a nibble-derived step.

name: stub_return_only
description: Routine that consists only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use, so it performs no work. The reference run reached it from outside the static flow.

name: copy_block_then_call_indirect
description: When the output pointer is non-null, copies sixteen 32-bit words from a fixed offset in a record into the output buffer, then makes an indirect call through a register-held routine address.

name: compute_max_and_build_buffer
description: Scans a linked list for the largest value in a field, then reserves a buffer through an indirect call and fills it with ascending words. It stores the address of a helper routine in the buffer header, copies sixteen words to and from a scratch area, and returns zero on success or minus one when the reservation fails.

name: run_execute_command_file
description: Entry point that opens a named command file and a temporary work file, then reads the command file line by line through dos calls. On failure it prints messages such as Can't open or Incorrect file name, and it parses the argument keywords for the script.

name: parse_directive_keyword_line
description: Parses one directive line by skipping blanks, reading a keyword token, and dispatching on its index. The keywords KEY, DEFAULT, BRA, KET, DOLLAR and DOT each store a one-character setting or a copied string, and any other token reports Invalid directive.

name: read_keyword_argument_text
description: Reads input characters into a key buffer until a delimiter or end of line, then copies the key text with its paired value. It reports Key too long when more than twenty characters are read.

name: read_single_character_token
description: Reads the next input token and returns its first byte. It returns minus two at end of line, and it reports an error through a library message routine when the token is longer than one character.

name: read_single_character_argument
description: Returns the first byte of the current argument token after checking that the token is exactly one character long. Otherwise it reports an Invalid directive argument error through a message routine.

name: finish_stream_and_release
description: Calls two dos library routines through the library base stored in a record, in order to finish a stream and release the resource it holds. It returns no value and writes nothing to the output.

name: flush_and_close_command_output
description: Flushes and closes the output stream of a command record when its handle fields are set, then runs the shared teardown routine and writes a newline terminator to the output.

name: call_two_library_routines_sequentially
description: Calls two dos library routines one after the other through the library base stored in a record. It takes no arguments and returns no value.

name: store_registers_to_pointer
description: Copies the data and address register values, plus the value on the stack, into successive entries of the array passed in, then returns zero. It is a context save with no library calls.

name: copy_struct_word_with_nonzero_guard
description: Replaces a zero second argument with one, copies the first 32-bit word of a structure into the location named by a pointer stored in that structure, and returns the adjusted argument paired with the structure's second word.

name: divide_long_by_long_signed
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor, negating operands to handle signs and applying the sign to the result. Positive operands use 16-bit division steps, with the divisor normalised by shifts before a multi-step quotient correction.

name: divide_long_returning_quotient_and_remainder
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor using a normalised method, returning the quotient in the high half and the remainder in the low half of a 64-bit result. A zero high half of the divisor uses direct 16-bit division steps instead.

name: run_logmerge_program_entry
description: Program entry that checks the first argument byte for a flag, then runs a sequence of library setup calls. It returns error code five when the first call fails and twenty when processing completes, and it calls a library close wrapper on the way out.

name: invoke_routine_sequence_with_flag
description: Makes five calls, makes an extra call only when a flag variable is nonzero, then makes two further calls before returning. The routine performs no memory access of its own.

name: process_entry_table_until_sentinel
description: Walks a table of fixed-size entries backwards from a stored count. It skips entries whose first field equals a sentinel constant, and for each other entry it makes calls that depend on a marker character stored in the entry.

name: accumulate_two_direction_results
description: Clears a result cell, copies two counter fields into a work pair and makes a call whose result is added to one accumulator. When a flag is zero it repeats with the counter fields swapped and adds the result to the other accumulator.

name: merge_records_by_key
description: Merges entries from a source table into a destination table. For each source entry it finds the destination entry with the same first field and overwrites its fields when the source is smaller, or otherwise appends a new entry and copies its fields, making unnamed routine calls for each update.

name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies a zero-terminated character string from a source address to a destination address, including the terminator. It makes no calls and performs no other work.

name: compute_negated_sum_checksum
description: Sums the words of a buffer, with the count derived from the size argument, then negates the total and XORs it with a fixed magic constant. The result is stored in the first word of the buffer as a header checksum.

name: verify_checksum_then_reset_entries
description: Recomputes the checksum of a buffer and, when the stored value does not match, fills a table of fixed-size entries with default values. Each entry receives a fixed pair of 32-bit defaults and a 16-bit default of fifteen thousand.

name: xor_scramble_words_backward
description: Walks a buffer of words backwards, replacing each word with the XOR of its own value, the following word and a fixed key constant. The buffer is scrambled or unscrambled in place and no library calls are made.

name: xor_scramble_words_forward
description: Walks a buffer of words forwards, replacing each word with the XOR of its own value, the next word and a fixed key constant. The buffer is scrambled or unscrambled in place and no library calls are made.

name: invoke_five_routines_in_order
description: Calls five unnamed routines in sequence and returns, with no other work in the body.

name: call_routine_with_optional_second_call
description: Calls an unnamed routine once, then calls it a second time only when a flag variable is nonzero.

name: call_single_routine_and_return
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns, passing no arguments of its own and performing no other work.

name: parse_logfile_argument
description: Parses a command-line argument whose leading at-sign marks an option, where a following S or s sets a silent flag. Otherwise it skips a device or directory prefix ending in a slash or colon and calls routines to process the name, returning zero on success or minus one on failure.

name: call_single_routine_and_return
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns, passing no arguments of its own and performing no other work.

name: copy_quoted_or_space_token
description: Copies one command-line token from source to destination. A leading double quote makes the next quote the terminator, otherwise the token ends at a space, a newline or the end of the string, and a terminating zero is written.

name: scan_string_for_stop_characters
description: Scans a string until it meets one of up to three stop characters, then returns zero. It returns minus one instead when it meets one of two forbidden characters first.

name: return_minus_one_with_stack_value
description: Returns a 64-bit result whose high half is minus one and whose low half is a value passed on the stack. It performs no calls and touches no memory.

name: scan_for_stop_or_forbidden_characters
description: Scans a string until it meets one of two stop characters, returning zero, or meets one of two forbidden characters, returning minus one. It makes no library calls.

name: read_file_into_allocated_buffer
description: Locks and examines a named file through dos calls, allocates a buffer sized to the file rounded up to a longword boundary, then opens and reads the whole file into it before closing and unlocking. It returns the buffer and its size in a 64-bit result, or zero when a step fails.

name: write_block_to_named_file
description: Opens a named file through dos, writes the supplied buffer to it, then closes the file. It returns zero on success and minus one when the open fails.

name: write_null_terminated_string_to_output
description: Measures a zero-terminated string and writes it to the standard output handle through dos Write. It returns the input register pair unchanged.

name: open_dos_library_bases
description: Opens the dos library through the exec library and fetches two handles from it. It returns zero when all three opens succeed and one otherwise.

name: allocate_tracked_memory_block
description: Stores a requested size in the first free slot of a 20-entry tracking table, allocates memory through an exec call, and saves the pointer in that slot. If the allocation fails, the recorded size is cleared.

name: free_tracked_memory_blocks
description: Walks the tracking table of allocations and frees each recorded block through an exec call until it reaches an empty slot.

name: compute_max_and_build_buffer
description: Scans a linked list for the largest value in a field, then reserves a buffer through an indirect call and fills it with ascending words. It stores the address of a helper routine in the buffer header, copies sixteen words to and from a scratch area, and returns zero on success or minus one when the reservation fails.

name: copy_block_then_call_indirect
description: When the output pointer is non-null, copies sixteen 32-bit words from a fixed offset in a record into the output buffer, then makes an indirect call through a register-held routine address.

name: launch_tool_from_icon_options
description: Program entry that reads command options such as WAIT, DELAY, STACK and WINDOW, loads an icon through icon-library calls, builds a console window description from them, and runs the tool. It returns error code twenty when setup fails and ten after the tool has run.

name: call_library_function_via_base
description: Calls one routine through the library base it is given, making no other calls and returning no value.

name: build_linked_entry_list
description: Allocates a node through an exec call and links a list of entries taken from a table in a structure, allocating each entry through a library call. It records a character count in the node header and returns the node, or zero when allocation fails.

name: invoke_stored_format_routine
description: Calls a formatted-output routine through a function pointer stored in the global data block. It takes no arguments of its own and makes no further calls.

name: copy_string_and_pad_zeros
description: Copies bytes from a source until a zero byte, stopping at a count limit, then pads the remaining destination space with zero bytes up to that count. It is a bounded string copy for fixed-size fields.

name: append_null_terminated_string
description: Moves to the end of the destination string and copies a zero-terminated source string onto it, including the terminator. It makes no calls.

name: multiply_fixed_point_words
description: Multiplies two 32-bit fixed-point values by combining the cross products of their 16-bit halves with the product of their low halves, and returns the 32-bit result.

name: run_loadwb_launch_entry
description: Program entry for the LoadWB command. It claims a message port, copies the command line into an argument array, and when a start message arrives it parses quoted arguments, decoding the escape codes for newline and escape. It then runs the tool and releases its state, returning error code twenty when the port cannot be allocated.

name: finish_launch_and_reply
description: Records a result code in the launch state, closes the file and library handles held there, frees the allocated block, and replies to the start message. It returns the stored result.

name: start_tool_from_decoded_strings
description: Opens the required libraries, decodes two strings with a fixed byte key applied twice, and allocates a 160-byte block. It then looks for a resident tool, starts it, and reports a failure message through a library routine when the tool cannot start.

name: compare_null_terminated_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte, returning minus one when the first sorts lower, one when it sorts higher, and zero when they are equal.

name: build_linked_node_list
description: Walks a table of entries, allocating a node for each through an exec call and copying an entry value into it. Nodes are linked in table order and the head of the new list is returned, or the list built so far if an allocation or value lookup fails.

name: write_release_suffix_on_match
description: Compares a version string against a stored release string, and when the stored string matches and the character at position twenty is a two, writes a period and four spaces as the suffix. Otherwise it returns after the comparison without writing.

name: write_period_and_spaces_suffix
description: Writes a period followed by four spaces into five consecutive bytes at a fixed offset of the buffer it is given.

name: match_stored_string_prefix
description: Advances through a stored string and the buffer together, returning as soon as the stored string ends and stopping early at the first mismatching byte. It writes nothing.

name: stub_return_only
description: Routine that consists only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use, so it performs no work. It is reached through the static flow of the executable and does nothing when run.

name: forward_call_with_stack_slot
description: Forwards its two arguments to an unnamed routine together with a pointer to a fixed stack slot, then returns.

name: format_message_and_emit_length
description: Calls a formatted-output routine through a stored function pointer, then measures the zero-terminated length of the formatted text in a 140-byte stack buffer. When the length is nonzero it passes the buffer and its length to a further routine.

name: store_byte_at_pointer
description: Stores the low byte of its data input at the address held in the pointer register and returns.

name: run_disk_validator_scan
description: Program entry for the disk validator. It prints a two-digit status counter, initialises a bitmap table of block entries, then walks the disk blocks comparing bitmap bits against stored status flags and calling disk and library routines to test each block.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The bytes here do not decode to a valid instruction, so there is no real routine. The decompiler stops at the undecodable entry and the reference run reached it from outside the static flow.

name: build_sorted_level_record_table
description: Opens the exec and dos libraries and reads lines from a data file into fixed-size records of packed values. It then sorts the records in place by a key field and assembles a formatted table of entries, each with a header and a text name, and appends a closing entry.

name: emit_formatted_entry_list
description: Builds a list of formatted entries from a name table, writing each name with a tag byte and a length header. It replaces the first open parenthesis in a name with a fixed marker string and appends a closing entry holding the final count.

name: store_args_and_call_library_pair
description: Saves its two register arguments in global slots, calls a library routine through the library base, then makes two more library calls. It returns a 64-bit result built from the saved values.

name: store_args_and_call_library_pair
description: Saves its two register arguments in global slots, calls a library routine through the library base, then makes two more library calls. It returns a 64-bit result built from the saved values.

name: store_args_and_call_library_pair
description: Saves its two register arguments in global slots, calls a library routine through the library base, then makes two more library calls. It returns a 64-bit result built from the saved values.

name: initialise_text_table_and_state
description: Initialises the program state: it clears a pointer table, fills a list of text entries with fixed prefixes and a numeric suffix, and loads data through library calls. It then splits a text block on caret and newline markers into separate strings and stores timing and display parameters in global variables before entering its main processing.

name: initialise_text_table_and_state
description: Initialises the program state: it clears a pointer table, fills a list of text entries with fixed prefixes and a numeric suffix, and loads data through library calls. It then splits a text block on caret and newline markers into separate strings and stores timing and display parameters in global variables before entering its main processing.

name: initialise_text_table_and_state
description: Initialises the program state: it clears a pointer table, fills a list of text entries with fixed prefixes and a numeric suffix, and loads data through library calls. It then splits a text block on caret and newline markers into separate strings and stores timing and display parameters in global variables before entering its main processing.

name: scan_low_four_bits_for_flag
description: Scans the low four bits of a flag word from the top bit downward and returns a value from zero to four that encodes the first bit found set, or zero when none is set. It makes no calls and writes no memory.

name: record_key_press_into_buffer
description: Clears a state flag, then makes a call to read an input value. When a counter is non-negative and the input is neither the escape code nor zero, it copies a sixteen-byte buffer backwards into a fixed location, stores the input in a global, and calls routines to handle the key.

name: clear_thirty_two_words
description: Zeroes a block of thirty-two 16-bit words starting at a global address and returns.

name: handle_control_key_codes
description: Checks the input character: a space or newline sets a countdown and a flag, and control characters 28 to 31 each set a shared control byte and clear a state byte.

name: lookup_name_table_entry
description: Searches a table of zero-terminated names, each followed by an aligned value word, for the stored key string. On a match it updates a global from the value word, and it stops when the table reaches a minus-one sentinel.

name: call_single_routine_and_return
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns, passing no arguments of its own and performing no other work.

name: clear_flag_and_invoke_stored_routine
description: Calls an unnamed routine, clears a counter global, calls a second unnamed routine, then calls the routine whose address is stored in a global pointer.

name: reset_tables_and_wait_for_frames
description: Resets game variables and clears two large word tables, then copies a table of pointers. It polls a global flag inside a fixed loop while updating counters, and finishes by invoking a stored routine that handles the display.

name: compute_timing_triplet_and_fill_table
description: Initialises three timing counters to a default of fifteen thousand when they are zero, derives a difference and a sum from them, and stores a third value. It then fills five six-word records with fixed pattern words and terminating bytes.

name: write_comma_and_byte_pair
description: Writes a comma character to one output position, then stores a global byte at two consecutive output positions.

name: sort_records_and_emit_entries
description: Copies pairs of values into five-word records with index numbers, sorts the records in place with a bubble pass that compares successive key fields, then writes a formatted list of entries. Each entry is built from a record's key and fixed marker bytes, and the list ends with a terminator byte.

name: format_decimal_five_digits
description: Writes an unsigned value clamped to 99999 as decimal digits, suppressing leading zeros, and writes a single zero when the value is zero.

name: format_four_digit_decimal
description: Writes an unsigned value clamped to 9999 as four zero-padded decimal digits, and writes four zeros when the value is zero.

name: copy_twelve_byte_record
description: Multiplies an index by twelve and copies a twelve-byte record from a table into two output areas, a longword and a word into each.

name: validate_config_words_and_wait
description: Copies seven table entries using running offsets, then checks eight configuration words against expected constants. When all match, it runs a polling loop and returns one on the stop signal, or zero otherwise.

name: shift_buffer_left_on_marker
description: Removes up to two leading ampersand markers from an eighteen-byte buffer, shifting the buffer left by one byte and clearing its last byte each time.

name: initialise_video_audio_and_game_state
description: Clears variable blocks and derives timing and scaling values from table lookups. It sets display and audio control values, builds a bit mask from configuration bytes for the copper and DMA setup, and calls the setup routines, returning zero on success or the setup result on failure.

name: write_newline_to_two_outputs
description: Makes two calls to unnamed routines and writes a newline byte to each of two output positions.

name: decode_word_table_and_clear_buffer
description: Copies a sequence of words from a table into a buffer, subtracting a fixed offset and byte-swapping each word according to a byte pattern until a negative end marker. When flags are set it shuffles a block of entries and byte-swaps a copy, then clears a 64-word block.

name: skip_strings_by_count
description: Computes a count from two state values and skips that many zero-terminated strings in a buffer, leaving the pointer at the start of the following string.

name: skip_strings_by_scaled_count
description: Computes a count by scaling a state value and skips that many zero-terminated strings in a buffer, leaving the pointer at the start of the following string.

name: update_colors_from_fire_button
description: Sets three display register words depending on a fire-button bit read from the CIA port and a hold counter, then advances a frame counter. It sets two flag bits when a position value passes two thresholds.

name: reset_counters_and_clear_block
description: Clears two counter globals, zeroes a block of sixty-four words, copies a state value into another global, calls an unnamed routine, and clears a flag.

name: poll_fire_button_state
description: Polls the two fire-button bits of the CIA port in loops, calling unnamed routines on each pass, and returns once the bits reach the required state.

name: poll_fire_button_until_ready
description: Polls the fire-button bits of the CIA port, calling unnamed routines on each pass, and returns when the required button state is met with a zero status value.

name: derive_scroll_offsets_from_value
description: Expands a byte into a repeated-nibble word and stores it with a fixed offset. It adds the input value to two accumulators, then derives two positional words by adding fixed offsets to the upper and lower halves of the input.

name: copy_or_clear_block
description: Walks ten-word table records and, for each record with a nonzero field, copies or zeroes an eight-by-eight block of longwords at a computed address. It waits for the blitter first and writes a single byte instead when a mode flag is set.

name: adjust_value_while_button_held
description: Derives a starting value from an input shifted right by nine bits, then adjusts it up or down within a range of one to 127 according to two direction bits while the control state holds. It returns the value shifted left by nine bits.

name: fill_pattern_table_with_marker
description: Fills a table of 127 longwords with a pattern value and overrides the entry matching a computed index with an alternative pattern. It then sets bits in a register word at an address derived from the input.

name: update_nearest_target_and_scroll
description: Selects the nearest of a list of twenty-byte records to the current position by comparing horizontal and vertical distances, then interpolates the scroll position toward the chosen target over eight steps. It switches the active record table when a change is requested, and returns early while a control or fire-state check is still active.

name: dispatch_command_record_opcode
description: Interprets one command record by switching on its opcode field. It stores values into global slots as words or longwords, scales and copies values, clears or copies blocks of records, updates a record table entry with default values and a text name, and handles scroll and input-state commands before calling a shared update routine.

name: spin_until_flag_clears
description: Increments a global byte in a loop until it wraps to zero, and repeats while the byte's low bit remains set. It then returns.

name: spin_until_flag_clears
description: Increments a global byte in a loop until it wraps to zero, and repeats while the byte's low bit remains set. It then returns.

name: spin_until_flag_clears
description: Increments a global byte in a loop until it wraps to zero, and repeats while the byte's low bit remains set. It then returns.

name: wait_for_raster_position_match
description: Polls a raster position byte until it equals the value passed in, and repeats while the byte's low bit is set. It then returns.

name: wait_for_raster_byte_nonzero
description: Polls a raster position byte until it becomes nonzero with its low bit set, then returns.

name: wait_for_raster_line_position
description: Waits on the raster position byte. When the high flag bit of the input is set it waits for the byte to match a value returned by an unnamed routine, otherwise it waits for the low byte of the input to match while the low bit is clear.

name: run_main_game_frame_loop
description: Runs the main frame loop, where each pass calls a block of update routines and decrements several countdown timers. It sets state flags when button checks fire, advances a counter table and a sequence pointer, and returns when one of several end-state counters trips.

name: clear_or_refresh_two_state_blocks
description: Either calls an unnamed routine or clears a 22-longword state block and sets a marker word, depending on a trigger flag and a button bit. It then does the same for a second state block.

name: advance_animation_frame_counter
description: Counts down a frame timer and, when it reaches zero, resets it and advances an animation state byte. When the selected source index changes it copies a 13-longword frame block from a table, or clears the block when the state byte is nonzero.

name: initialise_object_record
description: Initialises an object record from its arguments by storing two word parameters, clearing a counter and two pointer fields, and deriving a table pointer from a count minus one scaled by twenty-four. It takes its count from an unnamed routine and substitutes ten when that count is zero, then sets a fixed flag word.

name: call_two_routines_and_return
description: Calls two unnamed routines in order and returns, with no other work in the body.

name: check_point_hit_against_records
description: Tests a position against a bounding box stored in a table entry, with a margin of seven units. On a hit it advances the entry's counter, and when the counter reaches zero it resets the entry, stamps it with a time value, and sets an object flag.

name: read_keyboard_serial_and_toggle_flags
description: Reads a keyboard code from the serial register, inverts it and maps letter keys to pause, sound and control flags. The escape code clears the input state, and the tab code toggles a mode flag after the handshake is complete.

name: start_blitter_block_copy
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle and, when the first flag bit is clear, computes a source address from a table entry and a countdown. It then programs the blitter size, source, destination and control registers for a block copy and calls a routine to start it.

name: stub_return_only
description: Routine that consists only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use, so it performs no work. It is reached through the static flow of the executable and does nothing when run.

name: update_colour_pairs_by_counters
description: Updates two counters from input values and clamps them to a valid range. It then selects one of two colour register pairs for each group, depending on whether each counter has passed a threshold and is in range, writes the chosen words to output registers, and calls routines to finish.

name: compute_sprite_position_words
description: Scales two inputs by a factor and clamps them to a maximum, then derives three colour-coded bytes and words from them. Each value is set to zero or a fixed level when counters or edge distances apply, and the results are written to a fixed table or to the given record's slots.

name: process_entries_until_sentinel
description: Walks ten three-word table entries and calls two unnamed routines for each nonzero entry, choosing the routine by the entry's sign. It returns early when an entry holds the minus-two sentinel.

name: test_box_overlap_and_adjust_slot
description: Compares a record's position against a bounding box with two margins. When the position lies inside the box it subtracts an adjustment from a 32-bit slot in the entry.

name: test_box_overlap_and_add_slot
description: Compares a record's position against a bounding box with two margins. When the position lies inside the box it adds an adjustment to a 32-bit slot in the entry.

name: update_timed_spawn_records
description: Walks ten twelve-byte records and deactivates each one whose bit test or map check fails. For active records it counts down a timer, and when the timer reaches zero it resets it and appends a new entry with a start value to a list.

name: build_copper_list_entries
description: Advances an offset accumulator and writes a sequence of copper-list words into the display list at computed positions, waiting on a busy flag between writes. It returns a terminating word when the list is complete.

name: build_copper_list_entries
description: Advances an offset accumulator and writes a sequence of copper-list words into the display list at computed positions, waiting on a busy flag between writes. It returns a terminating word when the list is complete.

name: build_copper_list_entries
description: Advances an offset accumulator and writes a sequence of copper-list words into the display list at computed positions, waiting on a busy flag between writes. It returns a terminating word when the list is complete.

name: build_copper_list_entries
description: Advances an offset accumulator and writes a sequence of copper-list words into the display list at computed positions, waiting on a busy flag between writes. It returns a terminating word when the list is complete.

name: build_copper_list_with_blitter_wait
description: Builds a copper-list segment by writing position words at computed display addresses, waiting on the busy flag between writes. It programs blitter pointer registers before writing, and returns when the segment terminator is reached.

name: position_record_from_lookup_tables
description: Looks up two word values from tables indexed by the input and stores them as scaled longword fields in the record. It then updates the record's first two words by adding a delta and fixed offsets.

name: position_record_or_clear
description: When the index is within range, looks up two table values and adds them, with a fixed offset, into the record's first two words, then returns zero. Otherwise it clears the record's first two words and returns minus one.

name: update_projectile_spawn_timers
description: Advances spawn timers and, when one allows it, selects an entry type from a selector byte and places it using table values. It links the new entry into an active list through unnamed routines, then returns the record pointer.

name: scale_velocity_by_mode
description: Clears a word, then adjusts a velocity pair according to a mode byte. Mode three adds a scaled table value, mode two sets a flag, mode one negates the pair and sets a timer of fifty, and other modes divide the pair by four.

name: adjust_timer_and_positions_by_mode
description: Adjusts a timer and two position values according to a mode byte. It subtracts from the timer and adds a step to each value while they are below their limits, repeating while the mode byte is two.

name: set_word_when_mode_two
description: When a mode byte equals two, stores fifteen into a word, then calls an unnamed routine.

name: repeat_step_until_routine_succeeds
description: Clears a counter, then repeatedly calls an unnamed routine and steps a packed value by a delta, up to a fixed number of attempts. It returns early as soon as the routine returns a nonzero result.

name: update_object_motion_and_draw
description: Updates an object's position and velocity, clamps them against bounds, and applies a damped velocity step. When the object is active it builds draw descriptors for the blitter and copper and sets its state words.

name: update_object_motion_and_draw
description: Updates an object's position and velocity, clamps them against bounds, and applies a damped velocity step. When the object is active it builds draw descriptors for the blitter and copper and sets its state words.

name: reset_position_pair_when_flagged
description: When a pending flag is set and a range check fails, clears the flag, writes two derived values into an output pair from the record's fields, and zeroes two record words.

name: subtract_step_from_accumulators
description: Subtracts stored step values from two position accumulators, each only when its flag is zero, and calls an unnamed routine before each update.

name: lookup_distance_falloff
description: Computes the squared distance between a position and a target, then looks up a falloff byte in a table when the distance is inside a threshold. A close match subtracts a scaled penalty from a target word and returns a table-derived value, otherwise it returns the squared distance.

name: copy_pairs_with_derived_word
description: Copies a sequence of word pairs into two destinations, writing a third word for each entry derived from its second word by masking, shifting right and adding a fixed offset. It runs until a counter ends.

name: build_display_entry_control_words
description: Computes two vertical position values from display offsets, then writes control words for twelve display entries, each either active or disabled. It polls a register between the two passes and stores the list pointers at the end.

name: enable_audio_dma_channels
description: Computes an audio channel mask from two state flags and shifts it right. It clears pending channel pointers, waits until the vertical position passes a point, then writes the enable bits to the DMA control register.

name: pop_next_list_entry
description: Reads the next entry from a linked list. When the list pointer is null it stores a default pointer and a length of two, otherwise it copies the head entry's words and advances the list head, using a length of ten when the next entry is the list terminator.

name: reverse_velocity_on_edge_hit
description: Reverses a velocity component when a record sits at a boundary with a matching tile code and an unnamed check passes. It then either arms a pending marker or stops the motion when a block flag is set.

name: handle_tile_contact_for_two_records
description: For each of two records, checks the record's tile code and an unnamed check result. On a hit it sets the record's contact state and resets its velocity pair; a check of type three advances a counter and raises two position limits by fixed steps, while other types arm a pending marker and clear the stored value.

name: test_mask_region_for_collision
description: Tests a shifted bitplane window at a computed position against a mask. It returns early in each branch, performing no further writes.

name: scroll_and_draw_column_entries
description: Adjusts two scroll offsets by fixed steps. For a table index it either builds a new display entry with a computed address and count or advances a frame counter that resets at forty-four, and when an entry is present it clears masked bits across a block of twenty-six three-word entries.

name: scroll_and_draw_column_entries
description: Adjusts two scroll offsets by fixed steps. For a table index it either builds a new display entry with a computed address and count or advances a frame counter that resets at forty-four, and when an entry is present it clears masked bits across a block of twenty-six three-word entries.

name: write_blit_descriptor_record
description: Calls an unnamed routine for a value, then writes a block of descriptor words into a record: a flag word, the value, a sentinel longword, two pointers and two fixed constants.

name: write_masked_blit_descriptor_record
description: Calls an unnamed routine for a value, then writes a masked word and a set of descriptor words into a record. The record receives two pointers and two fixed constants, and the routine takes no further action.

name: advance_slot_counters_and_blit
description: Walks eleven three-word slots. Each active slot advances its counter, and when the counter reaches eight the slot is cleared. For a slot whose type flag is set it writes blitter descriptor words, computing the source address from table values.

name: write_blit_descriptor_after_wait
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, then writes a masked word and a fixed set of blitter descriptor words to a record, storing the given pointers and size word.

name: advance_wide_slot_counters_and_blit
description: Walks a list of wide slots, advancing each active slot's counter and clearing the slot at the end of its cycle. For a slot with its type flag set it writes blitter descriptors with a source address computed from table values, and writes an extra descriptor during the first half of the cycle.

name: compute_clamped_offset_value
description: Computes a weighted sum of two inputs and a table entry, scales it by sixteen, clamps it to fixed negative and positive bounds, and adds a base value.

name: update_two_pairs_from_results
description: Stores a saved value and sets two position fields from the results of unnamed routines, calling a routine first when a pending word is nonzero. It then calls ten unnamed routines in sequence.

name: step_counter_and_trigger_routine
description: When a state flag is clear, a counter is below a limit and a second value stays non-negative after a subtraction, advances the counter by three, stores a table word and calls an unnamed routine. It returns zero when that routine returns zero, otherwise one.

name: step_counter_and_trigger_routine
description: When a state flag is clear, a counter is below a limit and a second value stays non-negative after a subtraction, advances the counter by three, stores a table word and calls an unnamed routine. It returns zero when that routine returns zero, otherwise one.

name: decay_timers_and_process_requests
description: Processes two pending request flags, each calling an unnamed routine and, when that routine returns zero, storing a pointer and calling two further routines if a mode word is set. It then decays two countdown counters by one, or by three when a mode flag is set, clamping each at zero.

name: update_paired_objects_and_reset
description: Updates two paired objects per frame. It applies a fixed-fraction damping to velocities when a flag is set, decrements countdown counters, and resets an object's position and counters when its countdown goes negative. A mode-dependent collision response is applied against the pair of positions.

name: integrate_paired_object_motion
description: Advances two paired objects each frame. It reads the fire-button state to start shots, applies input-driven steps to velocities within limits, adds the velocities to the positions, and clamps the positions against a boundary.

name: stub_return_only
description: Routine that consists only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use, so it performs no work. The reference run reached it from outside the static flow.

name: stub_return_only
description: Routine that consists only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use, so it performs no work. The reference run reached it from outside the static flow.

name: pack_input_bits_into_state_byte
description: Packs input bits from a control word into a state byte. The low two bits and two higher bits are copied across, a fire-button bit is set when a mask bit is clear, and two flag words are cleared when a pointer passes a limit.

name: unpack_state_byte_into_input_word
description: Unpacks a state byte into a control word, setting the low two bits from the state and two higher bits from its upper bits. It then clears two flag words when a pointer passes a limit.

name: poll_joystick_port_inputs
description: Polls the joystick and mouse port movement registers and the fire-button state through unnamed routines. It updates held-count and pending-fire counters, storing the port values and resetting the counters when no button is held.

name: load_picture_file_into_buffer
description: Locks and examines a named file, then reads it into a buffer through dos calls. When the file starts with a four-byte marker it unpacks rows of words into interleaved planes, otherwise it copies the words directly. It returns the buffer and its length, or zero on failure.

name: derive_masked_colour_values
description: Sets a sign flag word from the input and substitutes a default mask when bit fourteen is clear. It stores the masked value and derived shifted and masked copies in global words.

name: allocate_into_free_tracking_slot
description: Finds the first free slot in a table of two-word records, records a requested size in it, and allocates memory through an exec call. It stores the pointer on success or clears the size on failure, and halts in an endless loop when the table is full.

name: free_all_tracked_allocations
description: Walks the tracking table, freeing each recorded allocation through an exec call and clearing its slot. Slots marked with the minus-one sentinel are skipped, and the walk stops at the first empty slot.

name: free_tracked_allocation_by_key
description: Searches the tracking table for an entry whose key equals the input, marks the entry with a sentinel, and frees its memory through an exec call. It stops at the first match.

name: stub_return_only
description: Routine that consists only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use, so it performs no work. The reference run reached it from outside the static flow.

name: restore_system_state_on_exit
description: Restores the system state on exit: it reloads a stored display list, closes the graphics and exec library handles, releases the blitter and returns the default view through library calls. It returns zero.

name: forbid_and_reply_pending_message
description: Forbids task switching and replies to a stored start message when its pending flag is nonzero, then returns zero.

name: draw_scaled_outline_steps
description: Computes the midpoints and half-extents of a rectangle from four coordinates, then loops over up to twenty scaled steps. Each step waits for a raster position and draws four points of an inner outline through an unnamed routine.

name: expand_packed_table_entries
description: Stores four-point bounds around two input coordinates and optionally calls two unnamed routines. It then walks a packed byte stream, expanding each byte through a lookup table into a sum with a signed offset and writing four words per group over eight passes.

name: fill_plane_blocks_per_pass
description: Calls an unnamed routine over a grid of four by four blocks for each of two passes, stepping the destination address by a fixed block stride. It then calls one further routine and returns.
